skills.name: vision-model-validation
skills.description: Validate an ONNX or Qualcomm AI Engine Direct (QNN) object detector, for example YOLOv8, used by VSaaS (private edge video intelligence with searchable insights) on a Qualcomm Dragonwing IQ-8275 (IQ8) board, and record each result labelled by model, backend and target.
useCases: Run the QNN YOLOv8 DLC on my IQ8 and record the result
Compare ONNX CPU and QNN results on the same video frame
Which backend and target produced this detection result?
Did my detector really run on the NPU, or only on the CPU?
Record detection count, top labels and scores for my test frame
